name: Kentucky
standard: Section 508 and Section 255 (KRS 61.980–61.988); Kentucky.gov states WCAG 2.1 adopted (level not stated)

laws.summary: State and state-assisted bodies must give people with disabilities IT access equivalent to others.

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

applies_to: The Commonwealth and state-assisted organizations: colleges, universities, nonprofits, political subdivisions, school systems and others funded by the state.

deadlines.what: Technology access clause required in all IT contracts entered into after this date
Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Equivalent access to IT for users who are blind, visually impaired, deaf or hard of hearing
Present information in visual and nonvisual formats
Bring pre-2000 IT into compliance when it is upgraded or replaced
mobile: not addressed — the statute predates mobile apps.
procurement: The Finance and Administration Cabinet's technology access clause is mandatory in IT contracts; exclusion is allowed only for assistive-technology cost that is an undue burden.
enforcement: Any injured person may sue for injunctive relief in Circuit Court within 4 years (KRS 61.988).
notes: The statute text is from KATS Network's reproduction, not legislature.ky.gov. No Commonwealth Office of Technology accessibility policy was found; a search result naming CIO-060 was wrong, since CIO-060 is the Acceptable Use Policy. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.
